sources.name: NASA POWER daily (MERRA-2 / GEOS-IT, precipitation from GPM IMERG)
NASA GPM IMERG daily (Early run for the newest day, then Late)

method.rainStatus: 30-day rain against the same 30 days in each past year: dry if at or below the 2nd lowest of 10, wet if at or above the 8th
method.soilStatus: root-zone soil wetness (0 to 1) against the same date in each past year, with the same cut-offs
method.hotDays7: days in the last 7 with a maximum of 35 C or more
method.caution: POWER's newest weeks come from near-real-time inputs (GEOS-IT, IMERG Early/Late), which read drier than the reprocessed archive used for past years, so dry labels are provisional until SMAP confirms them
